_comment: PR1 / INV-001 — the CLOSED legal (execution_status, comparison_status) table the PURE TOTAL classifier is enforced against. The cross-product totality test (AP-022/PMB-003) derives its expected legal-cell set FROM THIS FILE, never from a test literal, so shrinking the table is a reviewable committed diff. Wire tokens are snake_case and map 1:1 to the C# ExecutionStatus/ComparisonStatus enum members (PascalCase). Every combination NOT listed in legal_pairs is schema-invalid; any infrastructure fault maps to infrastructure_invalid/not_evaluated, NEVER comparison_status=different.
